title: TeachIntent Input Contract
description: Structural contract for the TeachIntent input (C, P, L, G) consumed by the Hy3 pedagogical speech planner. Source of truth: docs/problem_definition.md (Document Version 0.3, Input Schema Version 1.0.0-rc.2). Cross-field semantic constraints are NOT handled here; this file covers structural constraints only (Rule 15 division of labor in docs/speech_plan_schema.md applies by analogy).

schema_version.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.1: identifies the TeachIntent input schema; independent of the Speech Plan output schema version (which is 1.0.0-rc.3).

output_language.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.2: BCP 47 language tag. The pattern below is a lightweight/common BCP-47 syntax subset for supported TeachIntent languages (zh-CN, en-US, yue-Hant-HK, ...); it is NOT a full BCP-47 validator. The second pattern is a line-break guard neutralizing the Python re '$' trailing-newline quirk so the declared ECMA-262 anchor semantics hold under the jsonschema Python implementation.

instructional_content.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.3: case-level instructional knowledge. content_anchor is the case-level authoritative knowledge reference, not the final spoken transcript.

pedagogical_context.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.4: minimal single-turn teaching situation.

learner.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.5: explicitly supplied, pedagogically relevant learner information only.

pedagogical_intent.$comment: problem_definition.md section 4.6 and docs/pedagogical_intents.md section 4: exactly one primary intent from the six-way TeachIntent v1 control set. Secondary/compositional intents are not part of the v1 standard-case input schema. 'out_of_scope' is intentionally NOT in this enum (docs/pedagogical_intents.md section 2: dataset filtering/QC only).

nonEmptyString.$comment: Non-empty string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Input-contract strings are not required to be trimmed (trimming is required only for Speech Plan style descriptors).
